description.value: A functional MRI study comparing neural activity during anticipation, emotional reactivity, and cognitive reappraisal in avoidant personality disorder and healthy participants.

spans.text: The neural correlates of anticipating reappraisal as well as reacting to and reappraising aversive social images were compared in avoidant patients and healthy participants using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI).

value: We predicted that avoidant patients would show exaggerated anxiety relative to healthy participants as measured by behavioral self-reports as well as elevated reactivity in the amygdala, particularly during anticipation of reappraisal.
